data.notes: The report gets the most important things right. It scopes the win to online memberships, with the front desk still on Global and phase two undated, and it surfaces the Maya-chose/Greg-decided contradiction with the controller's own-file proof as the unlock. Its weaknesses are minor. The 'decided' insight goes past the transcript by asserting the two-week stall was about proof rather than price, and it does not restate that the unlock applied to online billing only. The language section marks the question not covered but doesn't label its cited phrases as incidental within the section, and the close lists 'who made the final call' as dodged even though the rep answered it at T20.
